name: pmmvy_verify_beneficiary
description: Authenticates the beneficiary via mobile OTP and returns a session_token. Prerequisite: None. Must be called before pmmvy_register_beneficiary, pmmvy_update_bank_details, pmmvy_update_mobile_number, and pmmvy_raise_grievance. Does NOT register the beneficiary.

mobile_number.description: The 10-digit mobile number of the beneficiary.

otp.description: The OTP received on the mobile number.

name: pmmvy_check_eligibility
description: Checks if a woman meets PMMVY criteria before registration. Prerequisite: None. Must be called before pmmvy_register_beneficiary for new applicants — confirms the woman meets PMMVY criteria before registration. Does NOT register the beneficiary or require authentication.

eligibility_category.description: The eligibility category of the woman.

child_order.description: The order of the child for which benefits are being claimed. second_child_girl only available under PMMVY 2.0.

name: pmmvy_register_beneficiary
description: Registers a new beneficiary for PMMVY benefits. Prerequisite: Requires a session_token from pmmvy_verify_beneficiary. pmmvy_check_eligibility must be called before this for new applicants to confirm they meet criteria. Does NOT check eligibility, application status, or handle grievances.

session_token.description:
Token returned by pmmvy_verify_beneficiary.
    Required for all authenticated tools. NOT required for
    the 6 public tools listed above.

aadhaar_number.description: The 12-digit Aadhaar number of the beneficiary.

eligibility_category.description: The eligibility category of the beneficiary.

child_order.description: The order of the child for which benefits are being claimed. second_child_girl only available under PMMVY 2.0.

name: pmmvy_track_application_status
description: Tracks the overall status of a PMMVY application. Prerequisite: None. Does NOT provide specific installment stages or actual payment status.

application_id.description:
PMMVY application ID generated at
    registration. Used for tracking and grievance tools.

name: pmmvy_check_installment_status
description: Checks the approval stage of a specific installment inside the PMMVY system. Prerequisite: Must be called before pmmvy_raise_grievance for payment delay complaints — confirm the installment is actually pending before filing. Does NOT confirm actual bank credit via PFMS (use pmmvy_check_payment_status for that).

application_id.description:
PMMVY application ID generated at
    registration. Used for tracking and grievance tools.

installment_number.description: The specific installment number to check. 1 = pregnancy registration, 2 = ANC completion, 3 = child birth + first immunisation cycle.

name: pmmvy_check_payment_status
description: Checks PFMS bank credit confirmation for an installment. Prerequisite: None. Does NOT show approval stages inside the PMMVY system; payment_status confirms actual bank credit via PFMS. Different from pmmvy_check_installment_status.

application_id.description:
PMMVY application ID generated at
    registration. Used for tracking and grievance tools.

installment_number.description: The specific installment number to check. 1 = pregnancy registration, 2 = ANC completion, 3 = child birth + first immunisation cycle.

name: pmmvy_update_bank_details
description: Updates the bank account details of an existing beneficiary. Prerequisite: Requires a session_token from pmmvy_verify_beneficiary. Does NOT update mobile number or eligibility.

session_token.description:
Token returned by pmmvy_verify_beneficiary.
    Required for all authenticated tools. NOT required for
    the 6 public tools listed above.

application_id.description:
PMMVY application ID generated at
    registration. Used for tracking and grievance tools.

new_bank_account_number.description: The new bank account number of the beneficiary.

new_ifsc_code.description: The IFSC code of the new bank branch.

name: pmmvy_update_mobile_number
description: Updates the registered mobile number of an existing beneficiary. Prerequisite: Requires a session_token from pmmvy_verify_beneficiary. Does NOT update bank details or other application data.

session_token.description:
Token returned by pmmvy_verify_beneficiary.
    Required for all authenticated tools. NOT required for
    the 6 public tools listed above.

application_id.description:
PMMVY application ID generated at
    registration. Used for tracking and grievance tools.

new_mobile_number.description: The new 10-digit mobile number to update.

name: pmmvy_check_anc_status
description: Checks the Antenatal Care (ANC) completion status for the beneficiary. Prerequisite: None. Must be called before pmmvy_raise_grievance when the complaint is about installment 2 being withheld — ANC incompletion is the most common cause of installment 2 delay. Does NOT raise a grievance or register ANC.

application_id.description:
PMMVY application ID generated at
    registration. Used for tracking and grievance tools.

name: pmmvy_raise_grievance
description: Raises a grievance for PMMVY related issues. Prerequisite: Requires a session_token from pmmvy_verify_beneficiary. Must call pmmvy_check_installment_status first for payment delay complaints. Must call pmmvy_check_anc_status first when the complaint is about installment 2 being withheld. Does NOT track an existing grievance.

session_token.description:
Token returned by pmmvy_verify_beneficiary.
    Required for all authenticated tools. NOT required for
    the 6 public tools listed above.

application_id.description:
PMMVY application ID generated at
    registration. Used for tracking and grievance tools.

name: pmmvy_track_grievance_status
description: Tracks the status of an existing grievance. Prerequisite: None. Does NOT raise a new grievance or check regular application status.

grievance_id.description: The ID of the previously submitted grievance.
